entries.title: Divine Nova
entries.body:
# Divine Nova

## Overview
When the battle reaches its darkest hour, you may call upon your patron to release a devastating surge of divine power from your very soul. This sacred eruption, known throughout Asteria as a Divine Nova, unleashes divine judgement upon those who oppose your patron while simultaneously blessing those who stand within their divine favour.

No two Divine Novae are ever identical. Every patron manifests this miracle according to their own divine nature. Some erupt as radiant light, others as crimson blood, spectral ravens, celestial fire, sacred waters, blooming life, or countless other divine manifestations. Though their appearance differs, every Divine Nova carries the unmistakable presence of the deity who bestowed it.

Those aligned with your patron's Divine Resonance feel warmth, strength, and renewed vitality. Those aligned with your patron's Divine Opposition experience the full weight of divine judgement, suffering the wrath of the covenant you have sworn to uphold.

## Rank 1
### Description

When the battle reaches its darkest hour, you may call upon your patron to release a devastating surge of divine power from your very soul. This sacred eruption, known throughout Asteria as a Divine Nova, unleashes divine judgement upon those who oppose your patron while simultaneously blessing those who stand within their divine favour.

No two Divine Novae are ever identical. Every patron manifests this miracle according to their own divine nature. Some erupt as radiant light, others as crimson blood, spectral ravens, celestial fire, sacred waters, blooming life, or countless other divine manifestations. Though their appearance differs, every Divine Nova carries the unmistakable presence of the deity who bestowed it.

Those aligned with your patron's Divine Resonance feel warmth, strength, and renewed vitality. Those aligned with your patron's Divine Opposition experience the full weight of divine judgement, suffering the wrath of the covenant you have sworn to uphold.

### Effects

- Spend **150 MP** and **40 SP** to unleash a **Divine Nova** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- The Divine Nova affects all creatures within a **10-metre radius**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** suffer **4d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** recover **2d6 HP**.
- The **damage type**, **creatures affected**, and **visual manifestation** are determined by your chosen patron's **Religious Page**.
- Creatures with immunity, resistance, or vulnerability to your patron's damage type resolve those interactions normally.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Among the greatest miracles recorded throughout Asteria's history, few are spoken of with greater reverence than the Divine Nova. It is said that, for but a single heartbeat, the veil between the mortal realm and the divine grows impossibly thin, allowing a patron's will to manifest through their most devoted champion.

Those who have witnessed such miracles rarely remember the destruction alone. Instead, they speak of the overwhelming presence that accompanied it—a feeling of standing before something infinitely greater than themselves. To the faithful, it is a reminder that while mortals wage war upon the world, the gods still watch over the fate of every soul.

> *"A Divine Nova is not born from anger, nor from vengeance. It is the moment a patron reminds the world that their will still shapes the course of history."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your Divine Nova grows in both power and reach, allowing a greater portion of your patron's will to manifest upon the battlefield. The divine energy surging through your body erupts with overwhelming force, bringing swift judgement to those who oppose your patron while extending a sacred blessing to those who stand within their favour.

Though every Divine Nova reflects the nature of its patron, its purpose remains unchanged—to remind the world that divine power is neither indiscriminate nor without purpose. Those who walk in harmony with your patron are renewed by its presence, while those who embody your patron's Divine Opposition are struck by righteous judgement.

Each invocation strengthens your connection to your patron, allowing more of their divine essence to briefly touch the mortal realm before fading once more.

### Effects

- Spend **200 MP** and **50 SP** to unleash a **Divine Nova** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- The Divine Nova affects all creatures within a **12-metre radius**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** suffer **6d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** recover **3d6 HP**.
- The **damage type**, **creatures affected**, and **visual manifestation** are determined by your chosen patron's **Religious Page**.
- Creatures with immunity, resistance, or vulnerability to your patron's damage type resolve those interactions normally.
- Additional effects granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Only those whose faith has deepened through countless trials are capable of unleashing a Divine Nova of this magnitude. Ancient texts describe these miracles as moments where the boundary between deity and disciple becomes almost imperceptible, allowing the patron's judgement to wash across the battlefield in a single overwhelming surge.

Witnesses often describe an indescribable feeling accompanying the Nova—an overwhelming certainty that they stood in the presence of something infinitely greater than themselves. Whether experienced as hope, fear, peace, or awe depends entirely upon the relationship between the observer and the patron whose will has been revealed.

> *"When a Divine Nova blossoms across the battlefield, even kings remember that every throne exists beneath the gaze of the gods."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your Divine Nova has become a miracle worthy of the greatest champions of your patron. No longer merely a burst of divine energy, it becomes a sweeping manifestation of your patron's will, surging across the battlefield with overwhelming force. Allies embraced by your patron's favour are renewed by its sacred power, while those who stand in opposition are struck by uncompromising divine judgement.

Each invocation leaves little doubt as to whom you serve. Whether it appears as radiant light, celestial fire, spectral ravens, sacred waters, blooming life, crimson blood, or another divine manifestation, every Divine Nova carries the unmistakable presence of your chosen patron. For a single moment, the battlefield becomes an extension of their divine domain.

Those who survive such miracles often remember not the pain nor the healing, but the overwhelming sensation of standing in the presence of a power far beyond mortal comprehension.

### Effects

- Spend **250 MP** and **60 SP** to unleash a **Divine Nova** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- The Divine Nova affects all creatures within a **15-metre radius**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** suffer **8d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** recover **4d6 HP**.
- The **damage type**, **creatures affected**, and **visual manifestation** are determined by your chosen patron's **Religious Page**.
- Creatures with immunity, resistance, or vulnerability to your patron's damage type resolve those interactions normally.
- Additional effects granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Throughout history, only the most devoted Paladins have wielded a Divine Nova of this magnitude. Entire battles have been remembered for the single instant in which a champion called upon their patron's power, forever changing the course of the conflict. Such miracles remind both ally and enemy alike that the gods do not merely watch the world—they are capable of shaping its destiny through those who have earned their favour.

Within the grand temples of Asteria, these moments are studied not as acts of destruction, but as manifestations of divine purpose. Every Divine Nova serves as a reminder that the covenant between patron and champion is more than faith alone—it is a sacred bond capable of briefly allowing the will of the divine to touch the mortal realm.

> *"When a champion becomes the voice of their patron, even the battlefield falls silent to bear witness."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your Divine Nova has become one of the greatest miracles your patron is willing to bestow upon a mortal champion. When invoked, divine power erupts from your soul in a breathtaking wave of sacred energy, washing across the battlefield with overwhelming force. For a fleeting moment, your patron's presence becomes undeniable as divine judgement falls upon those who stand in opposition while faithful allies are embraced by a surge of restorative grace.

Though every Divine Nova shares the same purpose, no two manifestations are ever alike. Some blaze with celestial radiance, others surge with raging infernos, spectral ravens, sacred tides, flourishing life, crimson blood, or countless other divine expressions. Regardless of its form, every Nova carries the unmistakable authority of the deity who empowers it.

Veteran warriors often claim that witnessing a Divine Nova changes them forever. Some describe overwhelming peace, others terrifying awe, but all leave the battlefield certain they have stood in the presence of the divine.

### Effects

- Spend **300 MP** and **70 SP** to unleash a **Divine Nova** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- The Divine Nova affects all creatures within an **18-metre radius**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** suffer **10d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** recover **5d6 HP**.
- The **damage type**, **creatures affected**, and **visual manifestation** are determined by your chosen patron's **Religious Page**.
- Creatures with immunity, resistance, or vulnerability to your patron's damage type resolve those interactions normally.
- Additional effects granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Only a handful of champions throughout Asteria's history have ever unleashed a Divine Nova of this magnitude. Entire wars have turned upon a single invocation, where the overwhelming manifestation of a patron's will inspired faithful armies while breaking the resolve of those who stood against them. Such miracles are forever remembered within the sacred histories of every temple.

The High Orders teach that a Divine Nova is never an act of anger or vengeance. It is a declaration that the covenant between patron and champion has reached such strength that, for one brief moment, a fragment of the divine is permitted to reshape the battlefield according to the patron's will.

> *"When the heavens answer a champion's call, the world remembers that mortals wage war only by the grace of the gods."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your Divine Nova has reached its ultimate form, becoming one of the greatest miracles your patron may bestow upon a mortal champion. With a single invocation, an overwhelming surge of divine power erupts from your soul, transforming the battlefield into a fleeting reflection of your patron's domain. For a single, breathtaking moment, the mortal realm bears witness to the majesty of the divine.

Every Divine Nova is unique to the deity who grants it. Some burst forth as blinding celestial radiance, others as roaring infernos, sacred tides, spectral ravens, flourishing life, crimson blood, or manifestations beyond mortal understanding. Though each appears differently, all carry the same unmistakable truth—the will of your patron has descended upon the battlefield.

To allies who walk in harmony with your patron, the Nova is a blessing that restores hope and strength. To those who embody your patron's Divine Opposition, it is a reminder that even the mightiest mortal cannot stand forever against divine judgement.

### Effects

- Spend **400 MP** and **80 SP** to unleash a **Divine Nova** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- The Divine Nova affects all creatures within a **20-metre radius**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** suffer **12d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** recover **6d6 HP**.
- The **damage type**, **creatures affected**, and **visual manifestation** are determined by your chosen patron's **Religious Page**.
- Creatures with immunity, resistance, or vulnerability to your patron's damage type resolve those interactions normally.
- Additional effects granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Legends tell of only a handful of Divine Novae ever reaching this level of power. Entire generations remember the places where these miracles occurred, often marking them as sacred ground where the veil between the mortal and divine worlds briefly grew impossibly thin. Whether remembered as acts of salvation or judgement depends entirely upon which side of the covenant witnessed the miracle.

The High Temples teach that a Rank V Divine Nova is not merely an expression of power, but the ultimate affirmation of trust between deity and champion. Such a miracle can only be performed by one whose faith has remained unwavering through every trial, every sacrifice, and every battle fought in the patron's name.

> *"For one heartbeat, the world remembers that the gods are not myths, but living powers whose will still echoes across creation through those worthy enough to bear their light."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.title: Sacred Covenant
entries.body:
# Sacred Covenant

## Overview
Your devotion has matured into a sacred covenant recognised by your patron. Through prayer, sacrifice, and unwavering faith, you may present an offering worthy of the divine, inviting your patron to answer with a miracle beyond the limits of mortal magic. Unlike other divine abilities, Sacred Covenant is not a spell to be controlled—it is a request placed before a god.

Every offering carries meaning. Some patrons value great wealth or powerful relics, while others cherish acts of self-sacrifice, unwavering conviction, or gifts with deep personal significance. The greatest miracles are rarely earned through material value alone, but through the sincerity of the sacrifice offered.

No two Sacred Covenants are ever identical. Every miracle reflects the ideals, personality, and divine portfolio of the patron receiving the offering. Whether answered with overwhelming judgement, miraculous salvation, divine guidance, or an unforeseen blessing, the outcome is always shaped by the will of the deity.

## Rank 1
### Description

Your devotion has matured into a sacred covenant recognised by your patron. Through prayer, sacrifice, and unwavering faith, you may present an offering worthy of the divine, inviting your patron to answer with a miracle beyond the limits of mortal magic. Unlike other divine abilities, Sacred Covenant is not a spell to be controlled—it is a request placed before a god.

Every offering carries meaning. Some patrons value great wealth or powerful relics, while others cherish acts of self-sacrifice, unwavering conviction, or gifts with deep personal significance. The greatest miracles are rarely earned through material value alone, but through the sincerity of the sacrifice offered.

No two Sacred Covenants are ever identical. Every miracle reflects the ideals, personality, and divine portfolio of the patron receiving the offering. Whether answered with overwhelming judgement, miraculous salvation, divine guidance, or an unforeseen blessing, the outcome is always shaped by the will of the deity.

### Effects

- Once per **Long Rest**, you may perform a **Sacred Covenant**.
- As part of the ritual, present an offering to your patron.
- An offering may consist of **Mana (MP), Stamina (SP), Health (HP), Zeal, currency, Soul Stones, relics, enchanted items, weapons, armour, magical materials, treasured possessions, death saving throws or another meaningful sacrifice approved by the GM.**
- Unless otherwise stated, all offerings are **permanently consumed** when accepted by your patron.
- Your patron may **accept**, **reject**, or **partially accept** the offering.
- If accepted, your patron grants a **Divine Miracle** appropriate to:
  - The value of the offering.
  - The significance of the offering.
  - The sincerity of the sacrifice.
  - Your standing with the patron.
  - The patron's Divine Resonance, Divine Opposition, and Divine Authority.
- The exact miracle is determined by the GM and should always reflect the nature and ideals of the patron.
- Miracles should remain within reasonable narrative and mechanical limits appropriate for the current campaign and the patron's divine influence.
- The appearance of every miracle is determined entirely by your chosen patron.

### Lore

The oldest scriptures teach that every covenant is built upon sacrifice. While many pray for miracles, few are willing to surrender something of true value in return. The gods are not merchants, nor are they compelled by mortal offerings. Instead, they judge the heart behind every gift, weighing conviction above wealth and devotion above pride.

Throughout Asteria's history, Sacred Covenants have shaped the fate of kingdoms. Some champions surrendered legendary weapons to save a city from ruin, while others offered years of accumulated wealth, fragments of their own life, or treasured family heirlooms in exchange for a single miracle. The greatest offerings were never remembered for what was given, but for what they represented.

Among the faithful, it is said that no offering is ever truly forgotten. Every accepted sacrifice strengthens the invisible bond between patron and champion, preparing the soul for the greater destinies that await those chosen to walk the divine path.

> *"The gods do not measure the weight of an offering by what leaves your hands, but by what leaves your heart."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your covenant has deepened, allowing you to present offerings of greater meaning and significance before your patron. No longer limited to simple sacrifices, your devotion is recognised as that of a trusted champion whose prayers carry greater weight within the divine realm. Though your patron remains free to accept or reject every offering, your growing bond allows increasingly extraordinary miracles to be bestowed.

Every covenant is unique. A weapon passed down through generations, a Soul Stone containing a fragment of immense power, a fortune accumulated through years of hardship, or even a portion of your own life force may all become worthy offerings. What matters most is not their value alone, but the conviction with which they are surrendered.

As your faith matures, your patron begins to reveal more of their divine will, answering worthy sacrifices with miracles that can alter the course of battles, save entire communities, or shape the destiny of those who place their trust in the divine.

### Effects

- Once per **Long Rest**, you may perform a **Sacred Covenant**.
- Present an offering to your patron as part of the ritual.
- Offerings may include **MP, SP, HP, Zeal, currency, Soul Stones, relics, enchanted items, equipment, magical materials, treasured possessions, permanent sacrifices, or another meaningful offering approved by the GM.**
- Unless otherwise stated, accepted offerings are **permanently consumed**.
- Your patron may **accept**, **reject**, or **partially accept** any offering.
- If accepted, your patron grants a **Divine Miracle** based upon:
  - The offering's value.
  - Its personal significance.
  - The sincerity of the sacrifice.
  - Your relationship with the patron.
  - Your patron's **Divine Resonance**, **Divine Opposition**, and **Divine Authority**.
- Compared to Rank I, your patron may now grant **Major Divine Miracles** when presented with sufficiently worthy offerings.
- The exact miracle is determined by the GM and should always reflect the ideals, personality, and divine domain of the patron.
- The appearance of every miracle is determined entirely by your chosen patron.

### Lore

Few champions ever earn the trust required to invoke a Sacred Covenant of this magnitude. Those who do discover that the gods do not merely observe sacrifice—they remember it. Every offering accepted strengthens the invisible thread binding champion and patron, allowing divine power to flow more freely between the mortal and immortal realms.

Many sacred texts recount miracles born from impossible sacrifices. Entire kingdoms were spared because a champion willingly surrendered everything they possessed, trusting completely in the wisdom of their patron. Such stories endure not because of the miracles themselves, but because they remind the faithful that true devotion is measured by what one is willing to give, not what one hopes to receive.

> *"The covenant grows not through the greatness of the miracle, but through the greatness of the sacrifice."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your Sacred Covenant has grown into one of profound trust, allowing your patron to answer offerings with miracles that shape not only battles, but the destinies of those who stand within their divine influence. Your faith has been tested through countless trials, and the bond between mortal and deity has become unmistakable.

Simple sacrifices are no longer the foundation of your covenant. At this stage, offerings often carry deep personal meaning—treasured relics, fragments of one's own life force, legendary possessions, or sacrifices that forever alter the champion who presents them. Such offerings are remembered by the gods, and their responses often become the subjects of scripture and legend.

Though your patron's will can never be commanded, your devotion has earned the privilege of requesting miracles that few mortals will ever witness.

### Effects

- Once per **Long Rest**, you may perform a **Sacred Covenant**.
- Present an offering to your patron as part of the ritual.
- Offerings may consist of **MP, SP, HP, Zeal, currency, Soul Stones, relics, enchanted items, legendary equipment, magical materials, treasured possessions, permanent sacrifices, or another meaningful offering approved by the GM.**
- Unless otherwise stated, accepted offerings are **permanently consumed**.
- Your patron may **accept**, **reject**, or **partially accept** any offering.
- If accepted, your patron grants a **Greater Divine Miracle**.
- The miracle is determined by the GM and should reflect:
  - The value of the offering.
  - Its personal significance.
  - The sincerity of the sacrifice.
  - Your standing with the patron.
  - Your patron's Divine Resonance, Divine Opposition, and Divine Authority.
- Greater Divine Miracles may influence entire battles, multiple creatures, significant locations, or alter events in meaningful but reasonable ways.
- The appearance and nature of every miracle are determined entirely by your chosen patron.

### Lore

By the time a champion reaches this level of covenant, their name is often spoken alongside the greatest servants of their patron. Their offerings are no longer viewed as transactions, but as sacred acts of devotion that strengthen the eternal bond between deity and disciple.

The greatest temples preserve countless stories of champions who willingly surrendered everything they possessed in exchange for a single miracle. Some halted invasions, others restored sacred lands, while a few forever altered the destinies of kingdoms. Such miracles were never remembered for their power alone, but for the faith that made them possible.

> *"The gods remember every sacrifice. The greatest miracles are not purchased—they are entrusted to those who have already given everything."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your Sacred Covenant has become one of the highest honours your patron may bestow upon a mortal champion. Your faith has endured countless hardships, your devotion has never faltered, and your sacrifices have proven your worth before the divine. Few champions ever reach this level of trust, for the gods grant such favour only to those who have demonstrated absolute conviction.

At this stage, every offering carries immense significance. Wealth, relics, fragments of your own life, treasured heirlooms, or priceless artefacts are no longer simply sacrifices—they become symbols of unwavering faith. Your patron weighs not only the value of the offering, but the meaning behind it, rewarding true devotion with miracles capable of changing the fate of entire kingdoms.

Though your patron remains beyond mortal command, your covenant has grown so strong that their divine influence can briefly reshape reality itself, provided the offering is worthy and the miracle serves their divine purpose.

### Effects

- Once per **Long Rest**, you may perform a **Sacred Covenant**.
- Present an offering to your patron as part of the ritual.
- Offerings may consist of **MP, SP, HP, Zeal, currency, Soul Stones, relics, enchanted items, legendary equipment, priceless artefacts, permanent sacrifices, or another meaningful offering approved by the GM.**
- Unless otherwise stated, accepted offerings are **permanently consumed**.
- Your patron may **accept**, **reject**, or **partially accept** any offering.
- If accepted, your patron grants a **Supreme Divine Miracle**.
- The miracle is determined by the GM and should reflect:
  - The value of the offering.
  - Its personal significance.
  - The sincerity of the sacrifice.
  - Your relationship with the patron.
  - Your patron's Divine Resonance.
  - Your patron's Divine Opposition.
  - Your patron's Divine Authority.
- Supreme Divine Miracles may influence battles, armies, cities, sacred locations, or other major events, provided they remain appropriate to the campaign and your patron's divine portfolio.
- The appearance and manifestation of every miracle are determined entirely by your chosen patron.

### Lore

Only the greatest champions throughout history have invoked a Sacred Covenant of this magnitude. The scriptures speak of heroes who surrendered crowns to end wars, shattered legendary relics to preserve entire civilizations, or willingly sacrificed decades of their own lives so that others might endure. These miracles became the foundation of countless religions, remembered not because of their overwhelming power, but because of the faith required to invoke them.

The High Orders teach that no champion truly commands the gods. Rather, a Sacred Covenant is an act of complete trust, where mortal and patron stand united for a single purpose. When such faith is answered, history itself often bears witness to the miracle that follows.

> *"The greatest offerings are never measured by what is surrendered, but by what remains worth protecting once the sacrifice is complete."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your Sacred Covenant has reached its highest expression. The bond between you and your patron has become so profound that your offerings are no longer viewed as mere sacrifices, but as sacred acts of absolute devotion. Few mortals throughout history have ever achieved such unwavering faith, for only those who have proven themselves through conviction, sacrifice, and selflessness are entrusted with miracles of this magnitude.

Every offering placed before your patron carries immense spiritual significance. Wealth, relics, kingdoms, legendary artefacts, fragments of your own soul, or even years of your remaining life may all become worthy sacrifices, provided they are offered with genuine devotion. The gods do not measure value by gold alone—they judge the heart of the one making the sacrifice.

When a Sacred Covenant of this rank is accepted, the miracle that follows becomes the direct expression of your patron's divine will. Such events are remembered for generations, recorded within holy scripture, and often become the foundation of legends that outlive the champion who invoked them.

### Effects

- Once per **Long Rest**, you may perform a **Sacred Covenant**.
- Present an offering to your patron as part of the ritual.
- An offering may consist of **MP, SP, HP, Zeal, wealth, Soul Stones, relics, enchanted equipment, legendary artefacts, permanent sacrifices, years of life, treasured possessions, or another meaningful sacrifice approved by the GM.**
- Unless otherwise stated, accepted offerings are **permanently consumed**.
- Your patron may **accept**, **reject**, or **partially accept** any offering.
- If accepted, your patron grants a **Legendary Divine Miracle**.
- The miracle is determined by the GM and should always reflect:
  - The value of the offering.
  - The personal significance of the sacrifice.
  - The sincerity of your devotion.
  - Your standing with your patron.
  - Your patron's Divine Resonance.
  - Your patron's Divine Opposition.
  - Your patron's Divine Authority.
- Legendary Divine Miracles may alter the outcome of wars, preserve civilizations, restore sacred places, banish overwhelming evils, or perform other extraordinary acts appropriate to the campaign and your patron's divine portfolio.
- No miracle may contradict your patron's nature or ideals.
- The appearance and manifestation of every miracle are determined entirely by your chosen patron.

### Lore

The oldest temples speak of Sacred Covenants with reverence, for they represent the highest form of devotion a mortal may offer before ascending to become a true divine champion. Every Legendary Miracle recorded throughout history began with a single act of faith—a champion willing to surrender something irreplaceable without certainty that anything would be given in return.

The gods have never been bound by mortal expectation. Some answer immediately, others remain silent, and a few respond in ways no mortal could ever foresee. Yet every accepted covenant leaves an indelible mark upon the world, reminding all who witness it that faith is not measured by the miracle received, but by the willingness to sacrifice without expecting one.

Those who master the Sacred Covenant stand upon the threshold of ascension. Beyond this point lies only the path of the **Avatar of Conviction**, where the champion ceases to merely serve their patron and instead becomes the living embodiment of their divine will.

> *"The greatest covenant is not the one that changes the world. It is the one that proves a mortal heart was worthy of changing it."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.body:
# Avatar of Conviction

## Overview
Your unwavering faith has earned the greatest honour a mortal champion can receive. For a brief moment, your patron allows a fragment of their divine essence to flow directly through your body, transforming you into their chosen Avatar upon the mortal plane.

While this transformation endures, your presence alone radiates overwhelming divine authority. Every action you perform reflects your patron's ideals, every strike carries their judgement, and every miracle manifests with unparalleled clarity. Though your mortal form cannot withstand such power for long, those few moments are often enough to alter the fate of an entire battle.

Every Avatar is unique to their patron. Some radiate blinding celestial light, others are surrounded by spectral ravens, crimson blood, divine storms, flourishing life, sacred flames, or manifestations beyond mortal understanding. Regardless of appearance, all who witness an Avatar know they stand before the living champion of a god.

## Rank 1
### Description

Your unwavering faith has earned the greatest honour a mortal champion can receive. For a brief moment, your patron allows a fragment of their divine essence to flow directly through your body, transforming you into their chosen Avatar upon the mortal plane.

While this transformation endures, your presence alone radiates overwhelming divine authority. Every action you perform reflects your patron's ideals, every strike carries their judgement, and every miracle manifests with unparalleled clarity. Though your mortal form cannot withstand such power for long, those few moments are often enough to alter the fate of an entire battle.

Every Avatar is unique to their patron. Some radiate blinding celestial light, others are surrounded by spectral ravens, crimson blood, divine storms, flourishing life, sacred flames, or manifestations beyond mortal understanding. Regardless of appearance, all who witness an Avatar know they stand before the living champion of a god.

### Effects

- Spend **500 MP** and **100 SP** to assume your **Avatar of Conviction**.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- Avatar of Conviction lasts for **5 Rounds**.
- While transformed:
  - Gain **Advantage on all Saving Throws.**
  - Gain **+2 AC**.
  - Increase all **Patron Damage** by **25%**.
  - Increase all healing granted by your patron's abilities by **25%**.
  - Your movement speed increases by **2 metres**.
  - You count as both your normal creature type and a **Divine Avatar**.
  - Your appearance transforms to reflect your patron's divine nature.
- All abilities continue to use your patron's **Divine Resonance**, **Divine Opposition**, and **Divine Authority**.
- Avatar of Conviction ends immediately if you become unconscious.

### Lore

Only a handful of mortals throughout history have ever been recognised as true Avatars. Such champions are remembered not for their own strength, but because the gods themselves chose to act through them. During these fleeting moments, the boundary between the mortal and divine realms grows thin, allowing a fragment of the patron's essence to manifest within their faithful servant.

The transformation is neither comfortable nor without risk. Mortal bodies were never meant to contain divine power, and even the greatest champions can sustain it only briefly before the strain becomes unbearable. Yet for those few moments, hope itself walks beside the faithful, and the enemies of the divine witness the full majesty of a patron's chosen champion.

> *"For a single heartbeat, the heavens do not merely answer—they walk beside us."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your patron now entrusts you with a greater measure of their divine essence. The transformation no longer merely empowers your body—it begins to reshape your very presence, allowing your conviction to radiate across the battlefield as a living symbol of your patron's authority. Allies fight with renewed confidence while enemies instinctively recognise the overwhelming power standing before them.

Though still fleeting, the Avatar endures longer and carries greater divine strength. Every miracle, every strike, and every act of protection reflects the unwavering bond between champion and patron. During these moments, your actions cease to represent your own will alone—they become an extension of the divine purpose you have sworn to uphold.

Every manifestation remains unique to your patron. Whether clothed in celestial radiance, sacred storms, spectral ravens, flourishing life, crimson blood, or another divine form, the Avatar is unmistakably recognised as one chosen by the gods.

### Effects

- Spend **600 MP** and **120 SP** to assume your **Avatar of Conviction**.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- Avatar of Conviction lasts for **6 Rounds**.
- While transformed:
  - Gain **Advantage on all Saving Throws**.
  - Gain **+3 AC**.
  - Increase all **Patron Damage** by **35%**.
  - Increase all healing granted by your patron's abilities by **35%**.
  - Increase your Movement Speed by **4 metres**.
  - Gain **Advantage on Saving Throws against conditions** inflicted by creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
  - You count as both your normal creature type and a **Divine Avatar**.
  - Your appearance transforms to reflect your patron's divine nature.
- All patron abilities continue to use your patron's **Divine Resonance**, **Divine Opposition**, and **Divine Authority**.
- Additional Avatar blessings granted by your chosen patron apply while transformed.
- Avatar of Conviction ends immediately if you become unconscious.

### Lore

Throughout history, only the greatest champions have sustained the divine presence for more than a fleeting instant. Their names are carved into temple walls not because they possessed unmatched strength, but because they remained worthy vessels through which their patron's will could be expressed. Every transformation is both a blessing and a burden, for the mortal soul was never intended to contain such overwhelming power.

As your covenant deepens, your patron places greater trust in you, allowing more of their divine essence to flow through your body. Each transformation strengthens the bond between deity and champion, preparing you for the day when your name will stand beside the greatest Avatars recorded in the sacred histories.

> *"Power alone does not create an Avatar. Only unwavering conviction can bear the weight of the divine."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your patron's divine essence now flows through you with remarkable clarity, allowing you to briefly transcend the limitations of mortality. During your transformation, you no longer resemble a mere champion of the divine—you become a living extension of your patron's will upon the battlefield.

The divine presence surrounding you inspires unwavering courage in the faithful while causing those who oppose your patron to hesitate before striking. Every movement carries supernatural grace, every miracle is amplified by your unbreakable conviction, and every enemy witnesses the terrifying reality of a mortal chosen to bear divine power.

Although the transformation remains temporary, your body has grown capable of sustaining a greater portion of your patron's essence. Legends tell of champions who stood alone against overwhelming armies during this sacred state, their conviction proving stronger than any blade.

### Effects

- Spend **700 MP** and **140 SP** to assume your **Avatar of Conviction**.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- Avatar of Conviction lasts for **7 Rounds**.

While transformed:

- Gain **Advantage on all Saving Throws**.
- Gain **+4 AC**.
- Increase all **Patron Damage** by **50%**.
- Increase all healing granted by your patron's abilities by **50%**.
- Increase your Movement Speed by **6 metres**.
- Gain **Advantage on Saving Throws** against effects originating from creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- Become **immune to the Frightened condition**.
- You count as both your normal creature type and a **Divine Avatar**.
- Your appearance transforms to reflect your patron's divine nature.
- Additional Avatar Blessings granted by your chosen patron apply while transformed.

- Avatar of Conviction immediately ends if you become unconscious.

### Lore

Few champions throughout history have ever attained this degree of divine embodiment. At this stage, the distinction between mortal servant and divine instrument begins to blur, allowing a greater portion of the patron's will to manifest through the Avatar. Entire battlefields have fallen silent upon witnessing such transformations, for even enemies recognise they stand before one chosen by powers far beyond the mortal realm.

Within the oldest temples, Rank III is regarded as the point where conviction itself becomes a weapon. The faithful no longer fight beside an ordinary Paladin—they march beside a living symbol of their patron's unwavering resolve, whose very presence inspires hope and challenges despair.

> *"Faith gives strength. Conviction gives purpose. An Avatar possesses both, and through them the gods change the course of history."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your conviction has reached a level where your mortal body can barely contain the divine essence entrusted to it. When your patron's power flows through you, the distinction between champion and deity begins to fade. Your presence alone inspires unwavering courage within the faithful while striking doubt into the hearts of those who oppose your patron's divine will.

During this transformation, the world itself seems to acknowledge your patron's authority. The ground beneath your feet trembles with sacred energy, your voice carries supernatural weight, and your body radiates the unmistakable presence of the divine. Every movement reflects absolute purpose, every miracle becomes a declaration of your patron's power, and every enemy understands they face more than a mortal warrior.

Although the transformation remains temporary, few beings can witness an Avatar of this magnitude without believing they have stood before a living legend.

### Effects

- Spend **800 MP** and **160 SP** to assume your **Avatar of Conviction**.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- Avatar of Conviction lasts for **8 Rounds**.

While transformed:

- Gain **Advantage on all Saving Throws.**
- Gain **+5 AC.**
- Increase all **Patron Damage** by **65%**.
- Increase all healing granted by your patron's abilities by **65%**.
- Increase your **Movement Speed by 8 metres.**
- Gain **Advantage on Saving Throws** against effects originating from creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- Become **immune to the Frightened condition.**
- Gain **Divine Levitation**, allowing you to hover up to **30 centimetres** above the ground. While levitating, you ignore difficult terrain and may move across water, unstable ground, and similar surfaces, but you do **not** gain the ability to fly.
- You count as both your normal creature type and a **Divine Avatar**.
- Your appearance transforms to reflect your patron's divine nature.
- Additional **Avatar Blessings** granted by your chosen patron apply while transformed.

- Avatar of Conviction immediately ends if you become unconscious.

### Lore

The oldest scriptures describe this transformation as the threshold where a champion's soul becomes capable of bearing an extraordinary fragment of divine essence. During these sacred moments, the Avatar no longer walks as an ordinary mortal. Every heartbeat echoes with unwavering conviction, every miracle reflects the ideals of their patron, and every action serves a purpose greater than themselves.

Many who have witnessed such Avatars claim that the champion never truly touched the earth. Whether this was divine illusion or undeniable truth remains the subject of theological debate, but all agree upon one certainty—those chosen to bear such power are remembered long after kingdoms have fallen and empires have faded.

> *"When conviction becomes absolute, the earth itself no longer dares burden the feet of the faithful."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 5
### Description

There exists no greater honour for a mortal champion than to be acknowledged as the living Avatar of their patron. Through absolute faith, unwavering conviction, and countless acts of devotion, you have earned the right to bear a fragment of your patron's divine essence without hesitation or fear. For a brief time, your patron walks the mortal realm through you, transforming your body into a vessel of sacred purpose.

During this transformation, your very existence radiates divine authority. Allies stand emboldened by your presence, while those who oppose your patron feel the crushing weight of an undeniable truth—they do not face an ordinary warrior, but the chosen champion of a god.

Every Avatar reflects the nature of their patron. Some blaze with radiant light, others command celestial storms, crimson blood, sacred waters, spectral ravens, flourishing life, or manifestations beyond mortal understanding. Regardless of form, all who witness an Avatar understand that they stand before a living legend whose conviction has become inseparable from the divine.

### Effects

- Spend **1000 MP** and **200 SP** to assume your **Avatar of Conviction**.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- Avatar of Conviction lasts for **10 Rounds**.

#### While transformed

- Gain **Advantage on all Saving Throws**.
- Gain **+6 AC**.
- Increase all **Patron Damage** by **100%**.
- Increase all healing granted by your patron's abilities by **100%**.
- Increase your **Movement Speed by 10 metres**.
- Become **immune to the Frightened condition**.
- Gain **Divine Levitation**, allowing you to hover above the ground. While levitating, you ignore difficult terrain and may move across water, unstable terrain, and similar surfaces, but you do not gain true flight.
- Your patron's abilities **ignore Resistance** to their damage type (Immunity still applies).
- You count as both your normal creature type and a **Divine Avatar**.
- Your appearance completely transforms to reflect your patron's divine nature.
- All **Avatar Blessings** granted by your chosen patron remain active throughout the transformation.
- Avatar of Conviction immediately ends if you become unconscious.

### Lore

Only a handful of mortals throughout all of Asterian history have attained this sacred state. Their names are preserved within holy scripture, their deeds immortalised through song and legend, and their sacrifices remembered wherever faith endures. To become an Avatar is not to replace one's patron, nor to rival them, but to become the purest expression of their will upon the mortal plane.

Many scholars believe the transformation is less a gift than a burden. Mortal flesh was never meant to contain divine essence, and every moment spent as an Avatar tests the limits of both body and soul. Yet those chosen accept this burden willingly, knowing that their purpose is not to wield power for themselves, but to serve as the instrument through which their patron protects, judges, and inspires the world.

When the transformation finally ends, the memory of witnessing it remains forever etched into the hearts of friend and foe alike.

> *"An Avatar does not ask the gods for strength. They become the strength the gods choose to send."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

None

entries.title: Sacred Judgement
entries.body:
# Sacred Judgement

## Overview
There exists no greater authority within the mortal realm than the judgement of a god. Through your unwavering conviction and absolute devotion, your patron grants you the sacred privilege of becoming the vessel through which their divine verdict is delivered. Unlike every miracle before it, Sacred Judgement is not an act of faith—it is the direct expression of your patron's will.

When invoked, your patron looks upon the chosen target and weighs them according to their own divine ideals. Every deity judges differently. Some offer redemption, others deliver destruction. Some restore life, while others demand sacrifice. Mercy, wrath, destiny, chaos, balance, and countless other ideals are all reflected in the judgement bestowed.

No mortal can predict the outcome with certainty, for Sacred Judgement is never governed by the desires of the champion alone. It is the decision of the patron, delivered through their chosen Avatar.

## Rank 1
### Description

There exists no greater authority within the mortal realm than the judgement of a god. Through your unwavering conviction and absolute devotion, your patron grants you the sacred privilege of becoming the vessel through which their divine verdict is delivered. Unlike every miracle before it, Sacred Judgement is not an act of faith—it is the direct expression of your patron's will.

When invoked, your patron looks upon the chosen target and weighs them according to their own divine ideals. Every deity judges differently. Some offer redemption, others deliver destruction. Some restore life, while others demand sacrifice. Mercy, wrath, destiny, chaos, balance, and countless other ideals are all reflected in the judgement bestowed.

No mortal can predict the outcome with certainty, for Sacred Judgement is never governed by the desires of the champion alone. It is the decision of the patron, delivered through their chosen Avatar.

### Effects

- Once per **Campaign Session**, you may invoke **Sacred Judgement**.
- Choose a creature, object, location, or event within **30 metres**.
- Your patron immediately passes divine judgement.
- The exact effect is determined by:
  - Your patron's Divine Authority.
  - Divine Resonance.
  - Divine Opposition.
  - The nature of the target.
  - The current circumstances.
- Sacred Judgement may bless, curse, heal, punish, empower, weaken, cleanse, transform, reveal, banish, or otherwise affect the chosen target in a manner appropriate to your patron.
- The final outcome is determined by the GM and should always reflect the ideals, personality, and divine domain of your patron.
- Sacred Judgement cannot force a result that would fundamentally undermine the campaign or contradict your patron's nature.
- The manifestation of Sacred Judgement is unique to every patron.

### Lore

Throughout history, Sacred Judgement has been witnessed only a handful of times. Entire civilizations have risen or fallen beneath its divine authority, yet no two judgements have ever unfolded in the same way. Every deity views creation through a different lens, and so every verdict reflects the ideals they embody.

The oldest scriptures teach that Sacred Judgement is not an expression of power, but of absolute truth. The champion does not command the miracle—they merely stand aside while their patron's will is made manifest upon the mortal world. Those who survive such moments often find their lives forever changed, whether by blessing, punishment, or revelation.

Among the faithful, it is believed that receiving Sacred Judgement is the closest a mortal may ever come to standing before the gods themselves.

> *"When judgement falls, even kings and monsters stand equal before the eyes of the divine."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your patron now entrusts you with a greater measure of their divine authority, allowing their judgement to reach further and carry greater consequence. You no longer merely invoke a miracle—you become the voice through which your deity pronounces their verdict upon the mortal world. Every judgement reflects not your own desires, but the ideals, purpose, and wisdom of the patron you serve.

Those who witness Sacred Judgement often speak of an overwhelming silence that falls before the miracle unfolds, as though creation itself pauses to hear the will of the divine. Whether the judgement arrives as mercy, punishment, redemption, or revelation depends entirely upon the patron whose authority you carry.

No two judgements are ever identical. Even when faced with similar circumstances, a patron may respond differently according to the sincerity of those involved, the significance of the moment, and the greater purpose they seek to achieve.

### Effects

- Once per **Campaign Session**, you may invoke **Sacred Judgement**.
- Choose a creature, object, location, or event within **40 metres**.
- Your patron immediately passes divine judgement.
- The judgement may affect **multiple closely related targets** when appropriate to the miracle and approved by the GM.
- The exact effect is determined by:
  - Your patron's Divine Authority.
  - Divine Resonance.
  - Divine Opposition.
  - The nature of the target.
  - The current circumstances.
  - The significance and purpose of the judgement.
- Sacred Judgement may bless, curse, heal, punish, empower, weaken, cleanse, transform, reveal, banish, or otherwise affect the chosen target(s) in a manner appropriate to your patron.
- The final outcome is determined by the GM and should always reflect the ideals, personality, and divine domain of your patron.
- Sacred Judgement cannot produce effects that contradict your patron's nature or fundamentally undermine the campaign.
- The appearance and manifestation of Sacred Judgement are unique to your chosen patron.

### Lore

As your covenant deepens, your patron grants you greater authority to act as their earthly representative. Few mortals are ever entrusted with such responsibility, for divine judgement is never given lightly. Every verdict echoes beyond the moment it is delivered, often shaping the destiny of kingdoms, faiths, and generations yet to come.

The High Orders teach that Sacred Judgement is neither vengeance nor mercy alone. It is the perfect expression of a patron's ideals, delivered without fear, prejudice, or hesitation. Those chosen to bear such authority are remembered not for the miracles they performed, but for the wisdom with which they accepted the burden of speaking with a god's voice.

> *"To speak with the voice of the divine is not a privilege—it is a burden few souls are worthy to carry."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 3
### Description

The bond between you and your patron has reached such depth that your voice may now carry a fragment of true divine authority. When you invoke Sacred Judgement, the heavens do not merely observe—they answer. Your patron weighs the hearts, deeds, intentions, and destiny of those before them, delivering a verdict according to their eternal ideals.

To stand before Sacred Judgement is to stand before absolute truth as defined by your patron. Some receive redemption, others condemnation. Some are granted impossible hope, while others witness the consequences of defying the divine. No two judgements are ever identical, for every verdict is shaped by the wisdom of the deity who delivers it.

Those fortunate enough to witness such miracles often spend the remainder of their lives attempting to understand the meaning behind what they have seen.

### Effects

- Once per **Campaign Session**, you may invoke **Sacred Judgement**.
- Choose one or more creatures, objects, locations, or events within **50 metres**, subject to GM approval.
- Your patron delivers a **Greater Sacred Judgement**.
- The judgement may affect individuals, groups, sacred sites, powerful artefacts, or significant events when appropriate.
- The miracle is determined by:
  - Your patron's **Divine Authority**.
  - **Divine Resonance**.
  - **Divine Opposition**.
  - The significance of the target.
  - The current circumstances.
  - The sincerity and purpose of the judgement.
- Greater Sacred Judgements may bless, curse, heal, condemn, empower, weaken, cleanse, transform, reveal hidden truths, banish powerful beings, alter fate, or otherwise reshape events in accordance with your patron's divine portfolio.
- The final outcome is determined by the GM and should always reflect the personality, ideals, and domain of your patron.
- Sacred Judgement can never produce an outcome that contradicts your patron's nature or bypasses the importance of player agency and the ongoing narrative.
- The appearance, manifestation, and consequences of every Sacred Judgement are unique to your chosen patron.

### Lore

Very few mortals have ever spoken with such divine authority. The oldest scriptures describe these champions as living heralds whose words briefly became indistinguishable from the will of the gods themselves. Entire nations have altered their course after witnessing a Greater Sacred Judgement, believing they had seen undeniable proof that the divine still walked among mortals.

The High Orders teach that the burden of Sacred Judgement grows heavier with every rank. To wield such authority is not to command a god, but to accept the immense responsibility of becoming the instrument through which their will is expressed. Every judgement shapes not only the world around it, but also the soul of the champion chosen to bear it.

> *"Power changes kingdoms. Judgement changes history."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron now entrusts you with an authority possessed by only the greatest champions in recorded history. Through your unwavering conviction, the boundary between mortal and divine grows perilously thin, allowing your patron's judgement to echo across battlefields, kingdoms, and sacred places alike. When you invoke Sacred Judgement, it is no longer viewed as a miracle—it is recognised as a divine decree that few beings possess the power to challenge.

The judgement delivered is never arbitrary. Every verdict reflects the ideals, wisdom, and eternal purpose of your patron. Some deities restore what has been broken, while others condemn corruption wherever it festers. Some reward sacrifice, while others demand justice. Whatever form it takes, every Sacred Judgement reminds the world that the gods remain active participants in the fate of creation.

Those who witness such miracles often devote their lives to recording every detail, believing future generations must never forget the day a god's will touched the mortal realm.

### Effects

- Once per **Campaign Session**, you may invoke **Sacred Judgement**.
- Choose one or more creatures, objects, sacred sites, locations, or significant events within **100 metres**, subject to GM approval.
- Your patron delivers a **Supreme Sacred Judgement**.
- The judgement may influence battles, armies, cities, sacred sites, legendary artefacts, or other major events appropriate to the campaign.
- The exact miracle is determined by:
  - Your patron's **Divine Authority**.
  - **Divine Resonance**.
  - **Divine Opposition**.
  - The nature and significance of the target.
  - Your standing with your patron.
  - The current circumstances.
- Supreme Sacred Judgements may bless, condemn, heal, empower, weaken, purify, corrupt, banish, transform, reveal, restore, or otherwise reshape reality in a manner consistent with your patron's divine portfolio.
- The GM has final authority over the judgement and should ensure every miracle reflects the ideals, personality, and limitations of the patron.
- Sacred Judgement can never contradict your patron's nature or remove meaningful player choice from the campaign.
- Every manifestation of Sacred Judgement is unique to the patron invoked.

### Lore

Very few Sacred Judgements of this magnitude have ever been witnessed. The oldest chronicles speak of wars ending in a single divine decree, cursed kingdoms restored through impossible mercy, and ancient evils cast from the world by champions whose faith never wavered. Such moments became defining events in history, remembered long after empires had risen and fallen.

The High Orders teach that a Supreme Sacred Judgement is never a display of power alone. It is the greatest expression of trust a patron can place in a mortal, allowing them to become the voice through which eternal ideals are briefly spoken into the world. Every champion who reaches this stage understands that the burden of divine authority is far greater than the power it grants.

> *"The greatest judgement is not the one that ends a war, but the one that teaches the world why it began."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 5
### Description

There exists no greater authority that a mortal may wield than the Sacred Judgement of their patron. Through absolute conviction, unwavering devotion, and a covenant forged through countless sacrifices, you have become the chosen vessel through which your patron may deliver their ultimate verdict upon the mortal realm.

When Sacred Judgement is invoked, your patron alone decides the outcome. Mortals cannot bargain, reason, or resist through will alone. Every judgement reflects the ideals, wisdom, mercy, wrath, justice, or purpose of the deity who delivers it. Some are granted redemption, others face condemnation. Entire kingdoms have been saved through a single judgement, while others have watched centuries of corruption brought to an end in a single divine decree.

Those who witness a Rank V Sacred Judgement rarely describe the miracle itself. Instead, they speak of an overwhelming certainty that, for one fleeting moment, they stood before the unquestionable authority of the divine.

### Effects

- Once per **Campaign Session**, you may invoke **Sacred Judgement**.
- Choose one or more creatures, objects, sacred relics, locations, armies, kingdoms, or significant events, subject to GM approval.
- Your patron delivers their **Ultimate Sacred Judgement**.
- The judgement may influence any appropriate target whose scale is reasonable within the current campaign.
- The judgement is determined by:
  - Your patron's **Divine Authority**.
  - Your patron's **Divine Resonance**.
  - Your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
  - The significance of the target.
  - The sincerity of your conviction.
  - Your standing with your patron.
  - The current state of the world and campaign.
- Ultimate Sacred Judgements may bless, condemn, heal, purge, restore, transform, banish, reveal, protect, destroy, alter destiny, or otherwise perform miracles consistent with your patron's divine portfolio.
- The GM has final authority over every judgement and should ensure that each miracle reflects the patron's personality, ideals, limitations, and role within the world.
- Sacred Judgement can never contradict your patron's nature, bypass meaningful player agency, or permanently undermine the integrity of the campaign.
- Every manifestation of Sacred Judgement is entirely unique to the patron invoked.

### Lore

The scriptures speak of only a handful of champions throughout history who have ever borne the authority to invoke the Ultimate Sacred Judgement. Their names became inseparable from the gods they served, remembered not for the power they possessed, but for the unwavering conviction that earned such unimaginable trust.

The High Orders teach that Sacred Judgement is not a weapon, nor a spell, nor even a miracle. It is the moment a deity chooses to speak directly into the mortal world through the soul of their most faithful servant. Whether that voice brings hope, justice, destruction, mercy, or renewal depends entirely upon the patron who answers the call.

Those who survive such moments often spend the remainder of their lives recounting the experience, for they know they have witnessed something that few mortals ever shall—the unmistakable will of a god made manifest.

> *"Power belongs to champions. Judgement belongs to the gods. We are merely the voices they choose when the world must listen."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.
